data.one_liner: Detects root on Android and jailbreak on iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: Uses RootBeer and DetectFrida for Android root detection, and IOSSecuritySuite for iOS jailbreak detection. It exposes methods to verify if the app runs on a real device, has root/jailbreak, or experiences security issues.
use_when: You need to prevent your app from running on rooted Android or jailbroken iOS devices
You need to verify if the app is running on a real physical device rather than an emulator
avoid_when: You are testing on emulators or simulators without expecting false positives
Your app does not require advanced security checks
strengths: Combines proven native libraries like RootBeer and IOSSecuritySuite
Provides simple asynchronous methods to query device security status
weaknesses: Emulators or simulators may cause false positives
Requires platform-specific configuration such as Info.plist entries on iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires adding platform schema queries to Info.plist on iOS for detection features.
data.minimal_example:
final isJailBroken = await JailbreakRootDetection.instance.isJailBroken;
final isRealDevice = await JailbreakRootDetection.instance.isRealDevice;
